description: Archive Courts of New Zealand X, Bluesky, LinkedIn, RSS, and email notification sources into GitHub and Hugging Face datasets
implementation_status: All phases and governance tasks are complete and archived. LinkedIn archive-only seed capture has 2 normalized/manual-seed records; email ingress, Hugging Face, Zenodo, archive capture, and source-health gates pass.
residual_risks: Permanent Cloudflare email address requires cost-bearing domain registration and remains blocked by the zero-spend guardrail until explicit approval.
LinkedIn remains source-only/archive-only; outbound posting requires a separate future Conductor track and risk review.
